cv.name: Niamh Furlong
cv.headline: Director, Clinical Operations | Phase I–III oncology and rare disease
cv.summary: Former oncology research nurse with eighteen years in clinical research across CRO, pharmacovigilance and sponsor roles. I have taken a few sideways steps on purpose, and now lead clinical operations for a Cork biotech running trials in Europe and the US.

experience.title: Director, Clinical Operations
bullets: Lead a team of 18 across study management, monitoring and clinical supplies
Accountable for four Phase II/III studies in 11 countries and a €45M clinical budget
Selected and oversee two CROs; renegotiated a contract saving €3.1M
Prepared the organisation for an FDA pre-approval inspection with no 483 observations

experience.title: Head of Clinical Monitoring (interim)
bullets: Ten-month interim role rebuilding the monitoring team after a merger

experience.title: Pharmacovigilance Manager
bullets: Managed case processing and signal detection for marketed products
Wrote PSURs and supported EU QPPV

experience.title: CRA, then Senior CRA
bullets: Monitored oncology trials across Ireland and the UK

extra_sections: Clinical research nurse, Cork University Hospital oncology unit, 2007–2010
